teacherGuide.conceptGu: ભાગાકાર = fair share. 12 cookies, 3 friends — each gets? Groups બનાવો physically. ÷ = split into equal groups. Multiplication reverse!
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Division is sharing equally / splitting into groups. It's the reverse of multiplication.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Division er at dele ligeligt eller opdele i lige store grupper. Det er det omvendte af multiplikation.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Pizza 8 slices — 4 friends share equally. Each gets? 8÷4=2. Robot distribute coins equally — same!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Pizza 8 slices shared among 4 friends equally. Each gets 2. Splitting things up evenly!
teacherGuide.storyDa: En pizza med 12 stykker deles ligeligt mellem 4 venner. Hvor mange stykker får hver? 12 ÷ 4 = 3!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: '12 LEGO bricks — 3 friends. Each friend same number. Deal out one by one — count each pile!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Use 12 LEGO bricks and share them among 3 friends. Deal them out one by one and count the piles.
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Tag 16 LEGO-klodser og del dem mellem 4 venner. Uddel dem én efter én, indtil der ikke er flere tilbage, og tæl hver bunke.
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Physical objects deal out — cards, coins, LEGO. See the equal groups. Then connect to ÷ symbol.
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Deal out physical objects like cards, coins, or LEGOs. See the equal groups, then connect to the division symbol.
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Uddel fysiske ting som mønter eller LEGO-klodser. Vis dem de lige store grupper, før I introducerer divisionstegnet.
